findings.observed: Original provider menu click-away can activate source underneath; Escape also closes picker.
findings.recommendation: Preserve transparent input-catching overlay and stop Escape propagation; restore focus.

findings.observed: Desktop download/season mode keeps a third empty action-grid column; gold choose action shifts left from original edge.
findings.recommendation: Use two action columns when per-title Download is absent.

findings.observed: Worker REPORT.json is absent; supplied captures lack source-byte hashes.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the missing original report as an explicit gap. Fresh finished artifacts, hashes, checks and this batch handoff are supplied.
findings.status: original input gap retained; corrected handoff supplied

findings.observed: Cancelling weak confirmation resets filtered rows; keyboard focus escapes to background controls.
findings.recommendation: Preserve search result state and scroll; contain modal focus and return it to selected row.

findings.observed: Archive choices show full directory paths instead of source basename; desktop query starts 10 px above QML anchor.
findings.recommendation: Use basename in label, retain full path in accessible name; restore desktop query anchor.

findings.observed: Failure and completion freeze indefinitely; batch/series live toasts claim Vol. 1 and batch can have no selected disc.
findings.recommendation: Match 1600 ms retry and 1400 ms completion beats; use batch and series context in disc and toast.

findings.observed: Long synopsis with 1.3 text and 24 px insets reduces short-landscape list to about one action height.
findings.source_reference: MangaTankobanSourcesPage.qml:hero/table/list; fitting rule permits existing content scrolling
findings.recommendation: Allow existing hero/table column to scroll only when result viewport would fall below usable height.

findings.observed: Worker mixes Main.qml reading-room shell with optional rebuilt masthead and chapter controls; desktop does not reproduce either route.
findings.source_reference: Main.qml:578-583,4991; MangaSeriesSharedHeader.qml; MangaChapterSeriesView.qml; TankobanSeriesView.qml:1179-1640; context classification item 7
findings.recommendation: Use explicit Main.qml default plus required restoration elements; retain optional rebuilt controls as labeled component comparison, not full route.
findings.status: fixed-verified for default; optional full rebuilt route not claimed

findings.observed: 107 count backed by only ten reachable volumes; all neighbours same scale; desktop action bar falls below viewport.
findings.recommendation: Populate full declared fixture, native scale falloff and centered endpoints; measure flow and reserve action bar.

findings.observed: Dropdown opens without option focus or collection keys; download skips queue/progress and loses focus; empty/loading/error/extension states absent.
findings.recommendation: Keep original anchored dropdown and local state transitions; preserve focus on rerender; add native empty and recovery states.

findings.observed: Bookmark was inverted to black; required wordmark/device progress/More absent; keyboard focus lost when virtual cards rerender; pending Read remains gold instead of outlined.
findings.recommendation: Restore source icon and mandated header elements; stable collection focus, scaled captions, pending state and native no-cover fallback.

findings.observed: Constrained original needs a cover below the native 190 px minimum in six tested viewports. Original worker short landscape makes the cover icon-sized. Updated proposal retains 190 px by reserving flow space and scrolling the existing page; at tight stress height chrome scrolls too.
findings.recommendation: Hemanth decides on measured scroll allocation. Use the completed proposed mock to inspect the cost; do not adopt a flattened flow.
findings.status: proposal implemented and verified; product decision open

findings.observed: A deliberately missing-metadata fixture exposed the copied renderer displaying NaN, -1 or an invented zero for unavailable seeders. This is a stress-fixture observation, not a claim about the default populated fixture.
findings.recommendation: Omit unavailable or invalid seeder metadata; retain a real reported zero.

findings.observed: The restored default chapter composition retained a 320 px page menu with 44 px desktop rows and a gold-tinted current option. Frozen source uses a 300 px cap, 36 px rows and Theme.glassHi.
findings.recommendation: Use source desktop menu geometry and glass states; preserve 44 px phone targets and viewport clamping.
